inputs.text:
Look, folks, we all know what’s really going on here. The progressive elites up in Albany have laid out their 2026 State of the State agenda, and it is nothing short of a direct assault on our traditions, our constitutional heritage, and our God-given right to protect our families and homes. 

They are pushing legislation that dictates how firearms sold in New York must be designed to prevent them from being modified, while slapping even more heavy-handed criminal penalties on law-abiding citizens. It is classic government overreach of the worst kind. Instead of focusing on basic law and order, personal responsibility, and holding actual criminals accountable, these ruling elites are attacking decent, hard-working people and eroding our fundamental Second Amendment rights. It is time for every patriotic citizen who believes in our cultural continuity and safety to stand up for our liberties and put a stop to this nonsense.
